units.source_text: “嗯，”千重子稍顿了顿，接着又说，“本来看过平安神宫的樱花，就该去看周山的樱花才好呢。

en.t: "Yes," Chieko paused for a moment, then went on, "After seeing the cherry blossoms at Heian Shrine, I really should have gone to see the cherry blossoms at Shuzan too.

units.source_text: 那棵古树……樱花已经看不成了，不过我想去看北山的杉树。

en.t: That old tree... the cherry blossoms can no longer be seen, but I want to go see the cedars of Kitayama.
It is very close from Takao, after all.

units.source_text: 望着那挺拔秀丽的北山杉，就感到心情舒畅。

en.t: When I look at those tall, graceful Kitayama cedars, my heart feels refreshed.

units.source_text: 你愿意陪我去看杉树吗？

en.t: Would you come with me to see the cedars?

units.source_text: 比起枫树，我更想看北山的杉树啊。”

en.t: More than the maples, I want to see the Kitayama cedars."
